create.name: David Elliott
create.bio:
David Elliott is a breathwork teacher and energy healer who grew up on a farm in Kentucky and spent the 1980s acting in film, television and advertising in Los Angeles. Meeting the healer Tim Heath helped him see that he could sense and shift held energy and that he heard guidance clairaudiently, and by the late 1990s healing work had taken the place of acting. He kept a practice in Los Angeles for many years and now does much of his teaching in New Mexico, where he founded the Creative Healing Arts Center, a non-profit retreat ranch near Tres Piedras.

His method rests on a two-stage pranayama breath that he uses to move people out of their thinking and into feeling, with self-love as the thread running through all of it. Since 2001 he has taught a graded Healer Training, now five core levels with further mentorship levels, which prepares students to hold space for one another and to lead breathwork circles; he runs it in New Mexico, California, Portugal and at Omega. He also leads healing groups and men's retreats, records guided meditations, and is the author of The Reluctant Healer, Healing and Men's Work: Breathwork & Brotherhood.

books.title: The Reluctant Healer
books.author: David Elliott
books.description: His first book, telling how an actor from rural Kentucky came, somewhat unwillingly, to accept his clairaudience and become a full-time healer. Journaling exercises and an introduction to his breath meditation run alongside the story.

books.title: Healing
books.author: David Elliott
books.description: A follow-up that goes further into the beliefs and old stories that block the flow of energy, with case histories from his sessions and practical exercises for readers' own inner work. He offers a free PDF of it on his site.

books.title: Men's Work: Breathwork & Brotherhood
books.author: David Elliott
books.description: A short 2026 book drawn from his men's retreats, on how breathwork and honest group sharing can help men meet themselves and one another more openly.

courses.title: Healer Training - Level 1-5, Sandia Park, NM, Mar 20 - 27, 2027
courses.description: The full five-level Healer Training in one residential week in the mountains east of Albuquerque. Students learn his two-stage breath, how to hold space for others, and how to lead breathwork groups, finishing with certification.
courses.price: $3,900 USD staying onsite, $3,200 USD staying offsite

courses.title: Healer Training - Level 1-5, Mendocino, CA, June 12-19, 2027
courses.description: The same five-level training held over a week in Mendocino, California, with registration through Spirit Camp. Students read his two books beforehand and work through set exercises from them.

courses.title: Healer Training - Levels 1-5, Portugal, August 19-27, 2027
courses.description: A residential run of the complete training at Cocoon, a yoga venue in Portugal, giving full certification in a single stay. Tuition is booked with him and accommodation directly with the venue.

courses.title: 2027 New Mexico New Year's Celebration - Dec 30 - Jan 2
courses.description: A four-day New Year retreat in Sandia Park, New Mexico, built around daily breathwork circles, fire ceremony and setting intentions for the year ahead.

courses.title: Spiritual Practice Meditation CD
courses.description: Four guided sessions of his two-stage breath meditation, at 7, 14, 21 and 28 minutes, for building a daily practice.

courses.title: Daily Meditation
courses.description: A gentle, heart-centred guided recording made for everyday use, sold as a download and also streamable on Spotify.

courses.title: Healing With Mother Earth 2
courses.description: A guided journey through the elements and the directions to deepen your relationship with the Earth, a companion to an earlier recording.

courses.title: TRUSTING OUR PURPOSE AS ARTISTS
courses.description: A guided meditation for creative people who feel called to share their voice and vision more boldly.

free_resources.title: Seven Minute Meditation
free_resources.description: A short guided session of his two-stage breath, from his Spiritual Practice album; Omega uses the same recording on its workshop page.

free_resources.title: HEALING (free PDF)
free_resources.description: His second book, which he offers as a free PDF download from his website.

flags: His Omega workshop 'The Healer Training: Levels 1-5' (6–15 Aug 2027, Member $2,295 USD, standard $2,395 USD) is LEFT OUT under the strict rule: Omega's description says the training clears 'unresolved trauma from childhood' and covers holding 'abuse, and trauma in the body'. His own listings of the same training name no condition and are kept. A human may decide to add the Omega item with a neutral description.

Much of his catalogue is condition-named (anxiety, fertility, grief, sexual abuse); only neutral items are listed. 'Healing' book blurb opens with 'a life of health and well-being' but names no condition; kept.

City set to Sandia Park, NM: his 2027 Healer Training and New Year retreat are at a Sandia Park address; his non-profit centre is near Tres Piedras, NM, and Omega describes a long Los Angeles practice. Remote sessions are mentioned in his training homework notes; the sessions page is a booking widget with no text.
No published email; contact form only. Sessions are booked through an Acuity page linked from the sessions page.
Mendocino training price is not shown on his page (registration via spirit.camp).
His Men's Retreat at Omega (30 Jul–1 Aug 2027) appears on his site but not on his Omega teacher page; left out (see left_out).
Possible confusion with other people named David Elliott on Amazon/Audible; the three books were checked as Hawk Press titles by this author.
